_scenario: Provider A (TZ) needs to route a payment to Kenya
_description: User in Tanzania wants to send money to M-Pesa Kenya. Provider A handles the TZ side but queries the directory to find a Kenyan provider.

step_1_discovery._action: Provider A queries for a Kenya M-Pesa off-ramp

step_2_result._action: Relay returns Provider B as a matching provider

step_3_attestation_check._action: Provider A checks attestations for Provider B

result._note: Provider A weighs these attestations by its own policy. The protocol defines no central trust score.

step_4_health_check._action: Provider A pings Provider B's health endpoint

step_5_settlement._action: Provider A pays Provider B using the LNURL off-ramp profile (spec/settlement-lnurl.md). Provider B uses a hold invoice, so the sats are captured only if the M-Pesa payout succeeds.

resolve._note: Lightning Address built from the lnaddr template in Provider B's listing, with the recipient's phone number as the username

step_6_complete._action: Provider A pays the hold invoice and polls the verify URL. Provider B delivers KES to the recipient over M-Pesa, then settles the hold. If the payout fails, Provider B cancels the hold and the sats return to Provider A.
step_6_complete.flow: User (TZ) → Provider A → Lightning (held) → Provider B → M-Pesa Kenya → Recipient
